hypothesis.null_hypothesis: SMA5/20 net performance does not exceed the deterministic in-sample unconditional-drift baseline for the same holding durations (DRIFT-MATCHED-v1 mean excess <= 0), or net expectancy <= 0 after BASE/STRESS costs.
hypothesis.purpose: PRE_REGISTERED_HYPOTHESIS_TEST on Development data only; Holdout never read.
hypothesis.question: On IBKR TSM 15-minute RTH bars, a completed-bar SMA5 crossing above SMA20 identifies short-horizon up-moves that continue long enough to earn a positive net return per round trip AFTER costs and BEYOND TSM's unconditional upward drift over the same holding time, consistently across the 2017-2024 development years.
hypothesis.testable_claim: Pre-registered success requires ALL of: (1) >= 30 valid round trips; (2) BASE and STRESS net expectancy > 0 and STRESS profit factor > 1; (3) DRIFT-MATCHED-v1 mean excess per trade > 0 under BASE (descriptive excess over the in-sample drift baseline); (4) net PnL > 0 in at least 5 of the 8 calendar years and in both halves 2017-2020 and 2021-2024; (5) no single calendar year provides more than 50% of total net PnL. Any failure = hypothesis not supported on Development data.

market_mechanism.causal_logic: Information about TSM reaches the US ADR gradually: Taiwan-session news and semiconductor-sector flows are absorbed by US participants over hours, and large holders split orders over the session. Gradual incorporation creates short-horizon positive autocorrelation of 15m returns; the counterparties are liquidity providers and slower participants who trade against the move. Long-only by construction.
failure_modes: overnight gaps (positions may be held overnight)
ADR reaction to Taiwan-hours information outside RTH
profit is long-only market beta from TSM's 2017-2024 rise rather than timing (tested by DRIFT-MATCHED-v1)
edge concentrated in one regime or year (tested by pre-registered year / half / regime decomposition)

changes.expected_improvement: an interpretable sample (hundreds of trades, 8 years, several regimes) to test the pre-registered hypothesis; no performance improvement claimed
changes.potential_side_effects: includes the already-seen month (disclosed; reported with and without it); one symbol only (survivorship); RESEARCH_ONLY costs
changes.proposed_change: all complete Development calendar years [2017-01-01, 2025-01-01), chosen by rule before any result on them

strategy_rules.entry_condition: Enter long when the completed-bar SMA5 crosses above SMA20 while flat (spec 0.2.0 = 0.1.1 rules).
strategy_rules.exit_condition: Exit long when the completed-bar SMA5 crosses below SMA20.
strategy_rules.exit_policy: Opposite crossover only; no stop, take-profit or time exit; overnight holding allowed.
strategy_rules.holding_horizon: several 15-minute bars to a few sessions
